prompt_en: An unmistakably adult 25-year-old Korean woman stands at a rain-glossed downtown crosswalk at night, photographed as a luxury fashion editorial. She pauses mid-stride after her phone lights with a message from someone she clearly knows; her razor-cool composure breaks for one heartbeat into a small, involuntary softened smile, and her hand tightens around a black fox phone charm. She wears a black micro-blazer, structured mini dress, and opaque over-the-knee stockings, with a clean band of exposed upper thigh between the short hem and stocking tops. Her knees close together and her legs remain adducted. The actual upper inner-thigh contours bound a narrow triangular background opening, a clearly defined thigh gap forming an attractive negative space with appealing focal geometry. It is an anatomical opening, not a wide stance or garment seam. A thigh-dominant framing to mid-calf keeps it legible at thumbnail scale and preserves a natural narrow space between her inner thighs. Foxlike winged eyeliner, a sleek black bob, chrome jewelry, and a sculptural handbag create sharp black luxury against a beautiful toxic city edge. Acid-green and violet neon reflect from wet pavement; off-axis night flash sculpts her silhouette. Realistic skin, crisp fabric, refined editorial restraint.
